name: duty-cycle-default
label: Daily near-work duty cycle: the distance and near viewing states the load history averages over (M5 plan, Task 5.6)

wakingHours.citation: assumption: 24 h less 8 h of sleep (adults are advised 7-9 h); loads are averaged over waking hours only, and the closed-lid sleeping state is not modeled.

distance.citation: assumption: distance viewing at optical infinity straight ahead (primary position), so no accommodation and no vergence.

near.citation: targetDistanceM: 35.0 cm, the mean smartphone reading distance of non-presbyopes in a study of 233 people aged 16-90 (36.8 cm overall, 39.0 cm in presbyopes; PMC8093538, search excerpt 2026-10-29); children read closer (24-27 cm in two small studies, excerpts), not modeled. directionDeg.y: -20 deg, the upper end of the 15-20 deg of downgaze by eye rotation during reading quoted by a practitioner article (eyesoneyecare.com, '20 degree rule', citing biomechanical studies it does not name; excerpt) and within the 15-60 deg near-vision declination of an ophthalmic-lens patent (excerpt); weak sources, an assumption in effect.
